items.title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 at lower prices
items.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.2 (all API customers and Claude apps) and Mythos 5.2 (restricted tier for vetted cybersecurity and life-science users). Both priced at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens; up to 30% faster than 5.1. Anthropic claims 1,000 Fable 5.2 agents formalized Fermat's Last Theorem in ~30 hours and that Fable 5.2 solved two open theoretical-physics problems (company claims, unverified).
items.why_it_matters: Newest top-tier model from a leading lab, with a price cut and gated access for sensitive uses.

items.title: AI stocks rebound after a $2.5tn sell-off, with rate and midterm worries behind the volatility
items.summary: AI-linked stocks lost about $2.5tn from the Nasdaq 100 on Nov 5, pushing the Nasdaq Composite into correction. On Nov 11 AP reported S&P 500 up ~1% and Nasdaq up 1.6%; Micron +11.7%, Broadcom +5.3%, Nvidia +3.2%. Hotter inflation raised Fed hike expectations, and investors worry Democratic gains could limit data-centre construction.
items.why_it_matters: Borrowing costs and possible data-centre restrictions are now tied to AI valuations.

items.title: Anthropic turns Claude into an office suite: Sheets, Whiteboards and Data
items.summary: From 10 November Anthropic began rolling out Claude Sheets and Claude Whiteboards in beta; Dashboards renamed Claude Data and generally available. Sources disagree on which plans get access.
items.why_it_matters: Claude goes directly against Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after board probe; Colette Kress named interim CEO
items.summary: Nvidia's board opened an independent probe (from ~Nov 8) into reports that Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort via an executive at Megaspeed, an Nvidia customer. On Nov 12 the board announced Huang is stepping down as president, CEO and board member; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and Harvey Jones becomes Chair. Chip-diversion and intelligence claims are unconfirmed.
items.why_it_matters: Nvidia chips underpin every frontier lab; a sudden CEO change affects supply chain and sentiment.

items.title: Utredning om KI i høyere utdanning (NOU 2026:14) overlevert
items.summary: Utvalget om KI i høyere utdanning har lagt frem NOU 2026:14. Dato usikker (pressemelding 6. nov, tale ved overlevering 9. nov). Utvalget mener innleverte tekster ikke lenger alene dokumenterer hva studentene kan, og foreslår kompetanseløft og nasjonal datainfrastruktur.
items.why_it_matters: Studentene på NHH og BI berøres direkte.

items.title: Google ships Gemini 4 Hydrogen as its agent 'daily driver'
items.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a cheaper tier of Gemini 4: $1.50 per million input and $7.50 per million output tokens, 1M context window; 51 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at high thinking. Available in AI Studio, Gemini API, Gemini app, Search, Sheets, Antigravity.
items.why_it_matters: Lower-cost agent model increases pricing pressure.

items.title: Regjeringen setter ned ekspertgruppe om KI-trusler mot norsk sikkerhet
items.summary: Digitaliseringsminister Torgeir Micaelsen har oppnevnt en ekspertgruppe ledet av Olav Lysne som skal vurdere KI-trusler mot Norges sikkerhet. Forslag skal leveres 1. mars og inngå i ny nasjonal KI-strategi og revidert sikkerhetsstrategi.

items.title: CoreWeave beats Q3 estimates and raises 2026 outlook; shares jump about 22%
items.summary: CoreWeave reported Q3 revenue of $3.66bn, up 168% year on year, and raised 2026 revenue guidance to $13.0-13.3bn. Backlog $132.5bn, net loss $709m, capex guidance $37-39bn. Stock rose about 22% on Nov 11.
items.why_it_matters: Read on AI compute demand and debt load.

items.title: OpenAI launches Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory security agents on GPT-6 Cyber
items.summary: Greg Brockman launched Daybreak Red Team (early access), agent fleets that pen-test web apps, and Daybreak Defense Factory, agents on GPT-6 Cyber that scan codebases and prepare merge-ready patches.
items.why_it_matters: Packaged enterprise cyber products compete with Anthropic's Mythos tier.

items.title: ChatGPT gets verified Business Agents (beta) letting users talk directly to brands
items.summary: OpenAI launched a beta where verified Business Agents let users start a branded conversation with a company in ChatGPT. Companies verify in a Business Hub showing mention frequency. Starts with selected US online stores.

items.title: Meituan releases LongCat-2.5, a 1.6T open-weight model, under the MIT license
items.summary: Meituan published LongCat-2.5 weights on Hugging Face under MIT license: MoE with 1.6T total and ~48B active parameters; 88.4 on Terminal Bench v2.1; hosted at $0.30/$1.20 per million tokens.
items.why_it_matters: Large open-weight Chinese model pressures closed labs.

items.title: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics 2.5 and AlphaGenome 2
items.summary: Gemini Robotics 2.5 reportedly reaches 96% on a Mercedes-Benz production-line task with Apptronik; AlphaGenome 2 finds causal DNA variants 30% of the time on TenK10K vs 16% before. Company-reported.
items.why_it_matters: Milestones in physical AI and biology.

items.title: Cursor makes Projects multiplayer: teams share agents, context and task board
items.summary: Cursor says Projects is now multiplayer, in beta to all users, with shared context, task board and coordinating agents.
items.why_it_matters: Agents move from individuals to teams.

items.title: NVIDIA unveils GR00T 2 robot foundation model at CoRL 2026
items.summary: At CoRL (9-12 November, Austin) NVIDIA presented GR00T 2 and a new open simulation benchmark for robot policies. Partners include Agile Robots and Unitree.
items.why_it_matters: NVIDIA positions as platform for embodied AI.

items.title: US labour market resilient while AI-linked layoffs continue; unemployment expectations highest since 2020
items.summary: October payrolls rose 165,000, unemployment 4.1%. NY Fed: expectation of higher unemployment a year ahead 45.3%, highest since April 2020. Challenger counted 43,994 October layoffs, down 71% y/y.
items.why_it_matters: Gap between hard data and AI job anxiety.

items.title: Banks' AI adoption: privacy concerns fall sharply, but few report measurable returns
items.summary: Financial Brand: community-bank data-privacy concern dropped ~22 points 2025-2026; Evident AI Index: 12% of use cases report KPI impact, ~1% concrete financial returns.
